title: Stain on Cake/Pie Server
text:
Stain on Cake/Pie Server. I ordered this set for a luncheon after a child's baptism. The set arrived in a Wallace box with a clear top. I looked at the items briefly and was happy with them at the time. Until I opened the box the night before the luncheon, however, I did not notice that the pie/cake server has a permanent stain - almost like a burn -- on the flat portion of the serving piece. Since I needed the item for the christening cake the next day, it was too late for an exchange. I used a very good brand of stainless steel cleaner per the directions on the Wallace package, but the stain seems to be permanent.

Needless to say, I am very disappointed in the quality control at Wallace.

The items are very pretty. They are lightweight and don't feel like heavy sterling silver serving pieces, but no one would expect them to have the weight of sterling silver at this price. If the pie/cake server had not been stained, I would have given the set five stars.
